cc:Work.dc:title: 06 | Cross-market falsification: Japan and UK
cc:Work.dc:description: Spent discovery: Feb 2020-Nov 2023 signal origins; Dec 2023 burnoff. Each panel: 96 local anchors x four OR lengths. Grey includes 95 scientific-invalid cells and two valid JP zero-trade cells. Values are price R, not broker-net money. No passing six-cell neighbourhood on either market; this rejects advancement of the tested ORB mechanism only.
